origin.summary: Elen, age 18, trained in young marsh guide apprentice, is drawn toward Whose earlier path is reflected by the lantern and is the route presently stable? Elen learned that a beautiful sign can be deadly when guides mistake it for safe passage.

origin_facts.fact: Elen is eighteen and works as young marsh guide apprentice.
Elen has learned that high-stakes observations must be distinguished from unverified conclusions.

Mirror Marsh contains causeways that can sink seasonally. Lanternkeepers record anomalous reflections but are forbidden to declare closed paths safe without repeatable outside surveys and authorized escorts.

formative_events.summary: During Elen's apprenticeship, training emphasized how an unverified conclusion can affect others.
formative_events.impact: Elen learned that a beautiful sign can be deadly when guides mistake it for safe passage.

origin_relationships.subject: Senior marsh warden
origin_relationships.historical_role: teaches disciplined investigation and holds professional authorization
origin_relationships.unresolved_tension: The young apprentice wants independence without treating institutional authority as proof.

unresolved_origin_questions.question: Whose earlier path is reflected by the lantern and is the route presently stable?

present_situation.summary: Elen faces an immediate unresolved case: An apprentice marsh guide discovers a lantern that records footsteps from a closed causeway and must decide whether to preserve or investigate the signal.
present_situation.current_location_context: Marsh Watch and other explicitly named authorized locations: Mirror Causeway, Reed Village, Lantern Archive
current_relationship_context: Keeper Oren teaches Elen lantern handling.
Village elder Mira insists that closed paths remain closed until inspected.
current_resources: a registered guide cord, one charged lantern and a permit ledger
oil lanterns, footbridges, guide permits and ferries
current_pressures: Declaring the path safe could lure travelers into a collapsing marsh; concealing observations could leave a village unprepared.
The route is briefly illuminated despite being shut.
Villagers need a truthful warning before the next tide.
current_open_questions: Whose earlier path is reflected by the lantern and is the route presently stable?
Which observations can be independently verified without inventing a cause?
immediate_desires: document the lantern response while keeping the sealed causeway inaccessible
immediate_avoidances: unapproved access to restricted places, records or devices

identity_anchors.statement: Elen distinguishes what was actually observed from what would be convenient to believe.

core_drives.drive: Whose earlier path is reflected by the lantern and is the route presently stable?
Prematurely reopening unsafe routes could endanger travelers and turn uncertain signs into false assurances.

core_fears.fear: Prematurely reopening unsafe routes could endanger travelers and turn uncertain signs into false assurances.

internal_tensions.description: Elen must make responsible choices even when the evidence is incomplete.

long_term_questions.question: Why does the sealed causeway's lantern reflect footsteps without a verified current traveler?

main_saga.title: The Remembering Causeways
main_saga.goal: Learn when the marsh's reflected footsteps correspond to trustworthy path information while keeping travelers safe and respecting closure permits.
main_saga.stakes: Prematurely reopening unsafe routes could endanger travelers and turn uncertain signs into false assurances.
main_saga.central_mystery: Why does the sealed causeway's lantern reflect footsteps without a verified current traveler?

anchors.title: Footsteps Without a Walker
anchors.purpose: Observe the lantern anomaly without treating reflections as people.
anchors.target_state: An unexplained signal is recorded and the causeway stays classified as sealed.

anchors.title: The Lamp's Memory
anchors.purpose: Trace ownership and charge limits of the lantern before proposing causes.
anchors.target_state: Lamp location, custodian and charges are accounted for.

anchors.title: The Uncertain Paths
anchors.purpose: Compare actual ground stability with remembered route accounts.
anchors.target_state: No causeway is declared safe from a single reflection.

anchors.title: The Gate of Permission
anchors.purpose: Learn what escort and documentation allow lawful investigation.
anchors.target_state: Any crossing occurs only after proper authorization.

anchors.title: A Route Worth Trusting
anchors.purpose: Develop safe mapping practices without predefining the lantern's origin.
anchors.target_state: Future guidance stays within observed evidence and earned permissions.
